q: What is the first test of any agent framework?
options: Whether you can see the exact prompt and request it sends
explain: If you cannot inspect the raw request, you cannot debug it.

q: What is the first thing to check when a framework-based agent behaves strangely?
options: The raw trace of what the framework actually sent to the model
explain: Hidden prompts and retries are common causes.

q: How do you keep framework exits cheap?
options: Keep prompts as your own templates and wrap framework calls behind your own interfaces
explain: Isolation makes replacement touch one module.
